column1: Auto-assign setup file reading per step?
column33:
h2. Impact

The bug causes the same lot# and wafer number to appear in multiple slots. This leads to incorrect data being processed during operations. 

h2. Expected behavior

The system should read the auto-assign setup file only once per slot. It should not overwrite the lot# and wafer number during the running process.

h2. Actual behavior

The system is repeatedly calling the auto-assign setup file, resulting in overwriting the lot# and wafer number. For example, lot# KG33NL7A and wafer number 06 in slot 14 were overwritten to KG33NL7A and 07 in step 3.

h2. Steps to reproduce

* Input lot# KG33NL7A and wafer number 06 in slot 14 using auto-assign setup.
* Start the running process.
* Observe the overwriting of the wafer number in step 3.

h2. Other information

The issue was previously fixed in abts-sw-v5.2.0 (ABTS-6368), which ensured the system reads the auto-assign setup file only once per lot.
